original_text: संज्ञाध्याये यस्य यद्द्रव्यमुक्तं कर्माजीवो यश्च यस्योपदिष्टः । भावस्थानालोकयोगोद्भवं च तत् तत् सर्वं तस्य योज्यं दशायाम् ॥ २०॥
transliteration: saṃjñādhyāye yasya yaddravyamuktaṃ karmājīvo yaśca yasyopadiṣṭaḥ | bhāvasthānālokayogodbhavaṃ ca tat tat sarvaṃ tasya yojyaṃ daśāyām || 20||
translation: When judging a dasha, apply the planet's stated qualities, its work and livelihood indications, and what arises from house placement, aspect, and yoga.
context_before: Chapter 8 is discussing dasha and antardasha handling.
